legs: Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera glides faster than the three adults walking ahead and passes them on their right, so they drop out of frame behind the camera in the first two seconds. It continues alone along the path onto the gravel terrace under the brick vaults and settles at the near end of the long candlelit table, where everyone is already seated and stays seated: a grandmother with her hair pinned up holding the blond toddler on her lap, the white haired man laughing beside her, the man with glasses passing a bowl, a girl filling glasses from a clay jug. Nobody walks up to the table, nobody stands up or sits down. Only one toddler in the scene. Vertical 9:16 frame.
